steps.title: Forecasts: the latest issuance, another source, an earlier issuance, a new and a late arrival

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended

steps.expected: The same watch, read back from the App.

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended
steps.caption: Edited: only the end time
steps.action: Edit watch, end 13:00, Save.
steps.expected: rainshadow.watches.update sends only the end; the same record now ends at 13:00.
steps.observed: GUI hike Saturday hike (Wren Lake) · Sun, Nov 22, 9:00 AM – Sun, Nov 22, 1:00 PM · Clear

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended
steps.caption: A form that went stale: the conflict is shown and the other change stands
steps.action: Edit watch; meanwhile another session renames it through MCP (request outside-edit); type “Stale label” and Save.
steps.expected: The App answers stale_version and the form says so; the label stays “Changed elsewhere”.
steps.observed: This record changed. Close this form and refresh before trying again.
steps.check: a stale form shows the conflict and the concurrent change stands

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended
steps.caption: The response is lost: the form says so and keeps its input
steps.action: New watch “Lost response”, Monday 09:00–11:00, send. The test drops the response after the App has committed it.
steps.expected: The form reports the failure and offers to send again with the same request ID.
steps.observed: Failed to fetch

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended
steps.caption: Sent again: still one watch
steps.action: Send again.
steps.expected: The retry is the same write with the same request ID: one watch.
steps.observed: Watch created.
steps.check: a retry after a lost response has one effect

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended
steps.caption: A window that ends before it starts is refused
steps.action: New watch, Monday 12:00 → 10:00, send.
steps.expected: The App answers invalid_window and the form says why; nothing is written.
steps.observed: start must be before end.
steps.check: an invalid window is refused visibly and writes nothing

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended

steps.action: Open the watch, Cancel watch.

steps.observed: Cancel Changed elsewhere? The watch stops checking the forecast and alerts. It stays in your history. Cancel Cancel watch

steps.title: Watches: saved, edited, stale, retried, refused, cancelled, ended
steps.caption: Cancelled: kept, and marked as cancelled

steps.title: An alert: acknowledging is refused while an update is unread, then recorded; the alert is cancelled
steps.caption: Start: the coastal flood advisory for Marrowby, not acknowledged
steps.action: Alerts: open al-0004.
steps.expected: One message, in effect, with an Acknowledge control.
steps.observed: Coastal Flood Advisory Public Forecast Office · Flood · z-marrow · Severe Active Expected Likely · Acknowledged: Not yet

state.alerts.get: al-0004 active, 1 message, latest al-0004-m1, acknowledged false

steps.check: the alert thread is shown message by message

steps.title: An alert: acknowledging is refused while an update is unread, then recorded; the alert is cancelled
steps.caption: An update arrives while the page is open: acknowledging is refused
steps.action: Infra applies rainshadow.alert.updated (event web-alert-update, message al-0004-m2); without refreshing, Acknowledge.
steps.expected: The page reads the thread again, finds a newer message and refuses; no acknowledgement is written.
steps.observed: A newer message arrived for this alert. Read it before acknowledging.
steps.check: acknowledging while a newer message is unread is refused and writes nothing

steps.title: An alert: acknowledging is refused while an update is unread, then recorded; the alert is cancelled
steps.caption: After Refresh: the update is first in the thread
steps.action: Refresh.
steps.expected: Two messages, newest first; the advisory now ends at 8 AM; Acknowledge is offered again.
steps.observed: Coastal Flood Advisory Public Forecast Office · Flood · z-marrow · Severe Active Expected Likely · In effect: Fri, Nov 20, 4:00 PM – Sat, Nov 21, 8:00 AM
steps.check: after Refresh the thread shows the update first

steps.title: An alert: acknowledging is refused while an update is unread, then recorded; the alert is cancelled
steps.caption: Acknowledged: the App records the message that was read
steps.action: Acknowledge.
steps.expected: rainshadow.alerts.acknowledge records al-0004-m2; the control is replaced by Acknowledged.
steps.observed: Coastal Flood Advisory Public Forecast Office · Flood · z-marrow · Severe Active Expected Likely · Acknowledged: al-0004-m2 at Fri, Nov 20, 8:05 PM
steps.check: acknowledging records the latest message

steps.title: An alert: acknowledging is refused while an update is unread, then recorded; the alert is cancelled
steps.caption: The forecaster cancels it: the alert closes and keeps its record
steps.action: Infra applies rainshadow.alert.cancelled (event web-alert-cancel); Refresh.
steps.expected: The alert is Cancelled, listed under Ended or cancelled, with three messages and the acknowledgement of al-0004-m2.
steps.observed: Coastal Flood Advisory Public Forecast Office · Flood · z-marrow · Severe Cancelled Expected Likely · Acknowledged: al-0004-m2 at Fri, Nov 20, 8:05 PM
steps.check: after Refresh a cancelled alert says so and keeps its acknowledgement
